name: Windmill HR
description:
Windmill is the AI-powered performance review platform for People Ops teams, and this connector brings your whole review workflow into Claude. Instead of clicking through dashboards, just ask.

Key features:
• Performance reviews: Track review cycles, see who's done and who still needs a nudge, and pull full context (feedback, AI recaps, 1:1 notes) when drafting a review.
• Feedback: Give feedback and shoutouts, request feedback about anyone on your team, and query everything that's been shared.
• 1:1s: Create recurring 1:1s, prep and update shared agendas, and check upcoming meetings.
• Pulse surveys: Create and schedule pulses, send them instantly, nudge non-responders, and analyze results.
• People data:  Query and update employees, manage groups, and invite workspace members.
• AI recaps: Pull weekly AI-generated summaries of each employee's work, surfaced automatically from connected work tools.
• Private notes: Keep running notes about colleagues that only you can see —
  ready when review season arrives.
• Workforce insights: Query aggregated stats and surface each person's top collaborators through organizational network analysis.

All access respects your Windmill role and permissions.

Try asking: "Who hasn't finished their reviews in the Q3 cycle?" — "Send the engagement pulse to the engineering team now" — "What did Marcus ship last week?" — "Summarize the feedback Sarah received this quarter."

_published_faq.name: How do I add Windmill HR to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Windmill HR to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gowindmill.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Windmill HR MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windmill HR lists 64 MCP tools, including employees_count, employees_groups_load, employees_query, employees_update, feedback_create, feedback_delete, feedback_edit, feedback_load_visibility_setting, feedback_query, feedback_requests_cancel, feedback_requests_create, and feedback_requests_query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Windmill HR?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Windmill HR in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Windmill HR MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windmill HR requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Windmill HR is developed by Windmill. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
